mito -data state.json src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- state.json --
{"list": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]}
-- src.cel --
{
	?"head":     state.list[?0], // Pure CEL spelling of (car state.list).
	"list":      tail(state.list),
	"old":       state.list,
	"want_more": state.list[?0].hasValue(),
}
